metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1950 · Winchester '73
metas.description: A cowboy's obsession with a stolen rifle leads to a bullet-ridden odyssey through the American West.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1964 · The Train
metas.description: In 1944, a German colonel loads a train with French art treasures to send to Germany. The Resistance must stop it without damaging the cargo.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1941 · High Sierra
metas.description: After being released from prison, notorious thief Roy Earle is hired by his old boss to help a group of inexperienced criminals plan and carry out the robbery of a California resort.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1928 · Steamboat Bill, Jr.
metas.description: The effete son of a cantankerous riverboat captain comes to join his father's crew.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1935 · Captain Blood
metas.description: After treating a Monmouth rebel against King James II in 1680s England, a young Irish doctor is exiled as a slave to Jamaica where he captures a Spanish galleon and becomes the most feared pirate of the Caribbean.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1966 · The Sword of Doom
metas.description: Through his unconscionable actions against others, a sociopath samurai builds a trail of vendettas that follow him closely.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1924 · The Navigator
metas.description: Two spoiled rich people find themselves trapped on an empty passenger ship.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1940 · The Mark of Zorro
metas.description: A young Spanish aristocrat must masquerade as a fop in order to maintain his secret identity of Zorro as he restores justice to early California.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1940 · The Sea Hawk
metas.description: Geoffrey Thorpe is an adventurous and dashing pirate, who feels that he should pirate the Spanish ships for the good of England. In one such battle, he overtakes a Spanish ship and when he comes aboard he finds Dona Maria, a beautiful Spanish royal. He is overwhelmed by her beauty, but she will have nothing to do with him because of his pirating ways (which include taking her prized jewels). To show his noble side, he suprises her by returning the jewels, and she begins to fall for him. When the ship reaches England, Queen Elizabeth is outraged at the actions of Thorpe and demands that he quit pirating. Because he cannot do this, Thorpe is sent on a mission and in the process becomes a prisoner of the Spaniards. Meanwhile, Dona Maria pines for Thorpe and when he escapes he returns to England to uncover some deadly secrets. Exciting duels follow as Thorpe must expose the evil and win Dona Maria's heart.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1943 · Sahara
metas.description: After the fall of Tobruk in 1942, during the Allied retreat in the Libyan desert, an American tank picks-up a motley group of survivors but they face advancing Germans and a lack of water.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1957 · Mother India
metas.description: In this melodrama, a poverty-stricken woman raises her sons through many trials and tribulations. But no matter the struggles, she always sticks to her own moral code.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1970 · White Sun of the Desert
metas.description: At the end of the Russian Civil War, Red Army soldier Fyodor Sukhov is ordered to guard the harem of a Caspian Sea guerrilla leader.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1925 · Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ
metas.description: A Jewish prince seeks to find his family and revenge himself upon his childhood friend who had him wrongly imprisoned.
